QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_66

question.text: Fund AUM: Peak INR 720 crore (March); Trough INR 540 crore (June); Subsequent recovery to INR 700 crore. Maximum Drawdown:

explanation.text: The Logic: MDD = (Trough − Peak)/Peak = (540 − 720)/720 = -180/720 = -25%. The Trap: Option B uses (peak − recovery)/peak. Option A inverts the ratio. Option D is wrong base. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-B tests MDD; XXI-B similar. Manager's Pro-Tip: Quote MDD along with benchmark MDD over the same window (Ex 9.9 showed -13.71% fund vs -38.78% NIFTY — contextual advantage). Always show recovery time too.
